about.description:
Timesheets from Jira worklogs - with manual time entry,
calendar and year view plus Excel and PDF export.
board.group.backlog_hint: ready to pull, not started yet
board.group.closing_hint: counted as done by Jira, still waiting to go live
board.group.handback_hint: deployed to production, waiting for the reporter to test
board.group.unknown_hint: status without an entry in the settings
board.needs_account: This view needs your own account id. It is not available in legacy mode (Data Center).
board.needs_settings: Please configure the Jira access in the settings first.
board.needs_team: Nobody added yet. Add colleagues whose ticket status you want to see under "My team" in the settings.
board.stats.ages: Idle time of open tickets (working days)
board.stats.footnote: Only what is currently assigned to you is counted. Work finished and then taken over by someone else is missing - the curve is a lower bound.
board.stats.title: Analysis
config.title: Configuration
confirm.delete_manual: The manual entry {ticket} from {entry_date} with {hours} h will be deleted permanently.
confirm.title: Really delete?
detail.author: Author
disclaimer.duty_authorisation: You will use this program only against Jira instances for which you hold explicit authorisation from their operator.
disclaimer.duty_export: Generated timesheets and exports may contain personal data. You are responsible for their distribution, retention and deletion.
disclaimer.duty_foreign_data: You will only evaluate data that you are permitted to view and process. If entries booked by other people are shown to you, you will verify that you are allowed to process them before making any further use of them.
disclaimer.intro: This program accesses a Jira instance through its REST API and reads work log entries from it. Which issues and which work logs become visible is determined solely by the permissions of your account. Depending on how rights are assigned, these may include entries booked by other people.
disclaimer.title: Use at your own risk
jira.error_html_hint: Note: response is an HTML page (likely proxy/WAF/login page), not a Jira JSON response.
jira.login_failed: Jira login failed. Please check the token.
log.hint_settings: [yellow]Note: Jira host and/or token not set. Press [bold][S][/bold] for settings.[/yellow]
log.ready: Ready. Press [bold][G][/bold] to generate the timesheet.
manual.err_hours: Please enter an effort greater than 0 (e.g. 3h 30m).
manual.err_ticket_or_summary: Please fill in at least ticket or description.
menu.manual_new: Record manual time for this day
notify.email_not_set: Email not set! Press [S] for settings.
notify.host_not_set: Jira host not set! Press [S] for settings.
notify.manual_delete_error: Manual entry could not be deleted
notify.manual_save_error: Manual entry could not be saved
notify.manual_select_first: Please select a manual entry first
notify.token_not_set: Jira token not set! Press [S] for settings.
save_dialog.title: Save timesheet as
settings.board_acceptance_tip: Waiting for approval by someone else.
settings.board_active_tip: Status values you are actively working in.
settings.board_backlog_tip: Ready to pull, but not started yet.
settings.board_closing_tip: The most important field. Status values Jira counts as done although the ticket still waits to go live - without this entry they show up in no list at all.
settings.board_done_tip: Really finished. A control view only: these tickets appear without any flag and without a threshold, so you can still see what is formally assigned to you.
settings.board_handback_tip: Deployed to production and waiting for the reporter to test it. If someone else reported it, the ticket belongs back with them - if you did, the ball is with you and the view files it under "My turn".
settings.board_intro: The view groups your tickets by whose turn it is. Enter the status names of your Jira instance per group, separated by commas. Anything you leave out is mapped roughly by Jira itself.
settings.board_priorities_tip: Order of your priority levels, most urgent first. Empty uses the built-in order.
settings.board_stale_days_tip: A ticket counts as stale after that many days without a change.
settings.board_threshold_tip: A ticket is flagged after that many working days without a change and without a logged hour. 0 disables the check for this group. The values are settings, not measurements.
settings.board_window_days_tip: Only consider tickets changed within that many days. Applies to "My activity". 0 disables the window.
settings.budget_detect_multi: Multiple fields found, first one set: {listing}
settings.budget_detect_need_creds: Host, email and token must be filled in.
settings.budget_detect_none: No custom field with 'budget' in its name found. Please enter it manually.
settings.budget_detect_tip: Reads all custom fields from Jira and fills in the budget field automatically. Cloud mode only.
settings.budget_field_tip: Custom field ID of the budget field (e.g. customfield_12345). On Jira Cloud you can find it via 'Auto-detect'.
settings.columns_hint: Display controls the list view, Export the Excel and PDF file. The label applies to the export; the list keeps its translated headings. Left empty, the default label applies.
settings.customers_tip: Comma-separated list for the customer dropdown in the manual time dialog.
settings.default_customer_tip: Used in the customer column for all entries fetched from Jira. Manual entries may differ.
settings.email_tip: Cloud: your Atlassian login email (for basic auth). Data Center (legacy): your Jira username.
settings.host_tip: Base URL of the Jira instance. Cloud: https://YOUR-COMPANY.atlassian.net (canonical URL, not the custom domain).
settings.hourly_rate_tip: Net hourly rate in EUR. Only for net/gross in the TUI summary and year view - not exported.
settings.manual_color_hint: Accepts #FF0000, FF0000, #F00 or 255,0,0. Invalid input falls back to red.
settings.manual_color_tip: Colour for manually recorded time in the list, Excel and PDF.
settings.proxy_hint: Behind a corporate proxy enter the proxy here, otherwise the connection fails with "All connection attempts failed". Format: http://HOST:PORT. Applies to HTTP and HTTPS.
settings.proxy_url_tip: Optional HTTP proxy for the Jira connection, e.g. http://proxy.example.com:8080 (corporate proxy). Leave empty for a direct connection; httpx will still read the HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY environment variables.
settings.target_export: Show target hours in Excel/PDF export
settings.team_duplicate: This account is already on the list.
settings.team_intro: Type a name and press Enter. Enter on a hit adds it to the watch list. Search by name, not by email address.
settings.team_name_ph: Display name, empty = name from Jira
settings.team_need_creds: Please enter host, email and token first.
settings.team_no_hits: No hits. A surname finds more than an email address does.
settings.team_pick_hit: Please select an account in the hit list first.
settings.team_pick_member: Please select a person in the watch list first.
settings.team_search_ph: Type a surname and press Enter
settings.ticket_links_export: Show ticket links in Excel/PDF export
settings.token_tip: Cloud: API token from id.atlassian.com. Data Center (legacy): personal access token (PAT).
settings.use_legacy_api_hint: Off = Jira Cloud (REST v3, basic auth with email + API token). On = legacy Jira Server/Data Center (REST v2, bearer token, ScriptRunner JQL).
settings.vat_rate_tip: VAT rate in percent for the gross calculation (default 19). Comma or dot as separator.
ticket_report.intro: Creates an interactive report on a ticket's life cycle: timeline, waiting times, people involved and key figures. The result is a single HTML file that works offline.
ticket_report.settings_missing: Access data is missing. Please set the Jira host and token in the settings first.
ticket_report.title: Ticket analysis
tooltip.anonymize: Replaces tickets, ticket text and authors with dummy values for screenshots. Real data is preserved in the cache.
tooltip.details: Shows all fields of the highlighted worklog entry including the ticket link in a modal dialog.
tooltip.excel: Exports the current timesheet as an Excel file with live formulas (hour and km chains stay editable).
tooltip.info: Shows version, author, license and a random quote about the app.
tooltip.manual_entry: Record time that is not booked in Jira, or edit the selected manual entry
tooltip.pdf: Exports the current timesheet as a PDF in landscape orientation.
tooltip.quit: Closes the application. Unsaved worklog data is not lost — it will be reloaded from Jira on demand.
tooltip.refresh: Fetches the timesheet or the visible ticket view fresh from Jira - bypassing the cache so that hours entered later show up
tooltip.reset_cache: Clears the local worklog cache (~/.jira-timesheet/cache). The next fetch will pull all months fresh from Jira.
tooltip.settings: Opens settings: Jira host/token, email, federal state, target hours, hourly rate, logo, language.
tooltip.switch_view: Switches between list view and calendar view of the current timesheet.
tooltip.theme: Switches to the next theme in alphabetical order (Ctrl+P opens the full theme picker).
tooltip.ticket_report: Turns a ticket into an interactive report as an HTML file - timeline, waiting times, people involved and key figures.
tooltip.tickets: Reloads the ticket view of the current tab. The status mapping lives in the settings under Tickets.
tooltip.toggle_log: Shows or hides the log panel at the bottom.
tooltip.year: Loads worklogs for every month of the year configured in settings and shows a yearly overview with forecast.
year.title: Year view {year}
